Insight46 phase 1 BRAIN test: a validated test for detecting signs of Parkinson's disease and other neurological conditions. Using a Lenovo Thinkpad laptop, participants were instructed to tap as fast and accurately as possible, alternating between the s and ; keys for thirty seconds, with each hand separately. In several cases, the hand used for each test may have been recorded incorrectly (indicated by a discrepancy between the data recorded by staff and the website).  This discrepancy has been coded with the variable “BT_rightleftuncertain_15“,the data is useable for analyses using a the mean of both hands, or “worst hand” analyses, but should be excluded if relationships with dominant or non-dominant hands are investigated. Also performed at phase 2 - see library file I46P2_braintap.
